### `GET /api/v1/users`

List users

List all users (admin only)

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `page` | query | integer | no | Minimum: 1. |
| `per_page` | query | integer | no | Minimum: 1. Maximum: 100. |
| `q` | query | string | no | Search query |

**Responses**

|---|---|---|

| `total` | integer | no | - |

### `PATCH /api/v1/users/{id}`

Update user

Update a user (admin only). Setting `disabled: true` keeps the account, blocks login and revokes its sessions and project tokens; `disabled: false` re-enables it.

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | path | string (uuid) | yes | - |

**Request body** (required)

`application/json`: object

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `disabled` | boolean | no | - |
| `email` | string (email) | no | - |
| `full_name` | string | no | - |
| `must_change_password` | boolean | no | - |
| `password` | string | no | - |

**Responses**

| Status | Description | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | User updated | `application/json`: [User](schemas.md#user) |
| `404` | User not found | - |

### `DELETE /api/v1/users/{id}`

Delete user

Permanently delete a user (admin only). The account row, its API tokens, sessions, project memberships, group links, permission assignments and SSO link are removed; creator/owner references on other objects are cleared. Refused for your own account (400) and for the last enabled admin (409). To keep the account, set `disabled` with PATCH instead. A later SSO login with the same external ID provisions a fresh user.

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | path | string (uuid) | yes | - |

**Responses**

| Status | Description | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `204` | User deleted | - |
| `400` | Cannot delete your own account | - |
| `404` | User not found | - |
| `409` | Cannot delete the last enabled admin | - |
